description: This file sets up dependency injection for webhook-related services, modules, and factories within a webhooks feature. It creates a container, loads various modules and services, and provides accessor functions for the webhook feature, task consumer, and producer.

classes.name: Container
classes.description: Dependency injection container for webhook services and modules.

methods.name: getWebhookTaskConsumer
methods.description: Returns the WebhookTaskConsumer instance used internally by the webhook task handler.

methods.name: getWebhookFeature
methods.description: Provides a unified, type-safe API to access all webhook services and components.

methods.name: getWebhookProducer
methods.description: Returns a lightweight webhook producer service for queuing webhooks.
